author: JamBalaya56562
body:
Verified on main [626f10a35876753f0a2f36d414c878c91a819067](https://github.com/duplicati/ngclient/commit/626f10a35876753f0a2f36d414c878c91a819067).

#618 addresses the load/serialize feedback loop by preserving the saved URL and applying only explicit edits. Verified scope: I reran `destination-edit-session.spec.ts` and `single-destination.render.spec.ts`; both passed, covering untouched URL values, unknown/repeated query parameters, credentials, and parse/mapper failures across their regression cases.

These are unit/component checks, not live connection tests for every provider. Is there a specific editor or configuration that still loses settings, or another remaining case you would like covered here?
